resourceGroup.description: The API group of the Configuration kinds. Must match github-provider-kog's resourceGroup.

configurationName.description: The name both Configurations carry. builder-publish references this name by default.

secretName.description: The Secret holding the GitHub token, in the release namespace. This chart does not create it.

secretKey.description: The key in that Secret that holds the token.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected by the chart-inspector / when used as a subchart).
